blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Ayala Corp. seeks to buy back up to P19.5 billion worth of shares from public investors as it advances a planned deal with Japanese giant Mitsubishi Corp. On Wednesday, the group said it plans to launch a voluntary tender offer to buy 30.06 million common shares from all holders. READ: Mitsubishi to raise Ayala stake through P 44.5-billion deal This represents about 4.85 percent of its total issued and outstanding common shares, priced at P650 apiece.
